verbetes.glosa_atual: matéria mole ou flácida; gordura ou restos gordurosos de carne.
definicoes_originais: ch. m. (b. h. אֱלִל Job XIII, 4; v. אֱלִיל; cmp. הלל) soft, lax object, whence fatty substance, offal of meat.
notas_originais: Targ. Job. l. c.—Ḥull. IX, 1 (Gem. 121 a, diff. of opin. as to what kind of offal is meant in the Mish., v. מַרְדְּקָא). Ib. הא' המכונס the offal gathered (as a ball). Zeb. III, 4.—Toh. I, 4 אֱלִיל. Meil. 7 a א' כיון דלית ביה וכ' ălal, because there is no substantial value in it. Zeb. 35 a פיגל בא' if one had an inappropriate thought about ălal of fowls (which is fit to eat).

verbetes.glosa_atual: prensagem de uvas ou azeitonas; porção colocada de uma só vez no lagar.
definicoes_originais: (אֲלַל; cmp. b. h. דָּרַךְ) treading the wine or olive press; quantity put into the press at a time.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 105 a הא באתרא … בא' Ar. (ed. או') the one Rabbi treats of a place where they ordinarily put one khor (measure) into the press at a time, &c. Esth. R. to I, 2 (referring to Esth. l. c., and Neh. XIII, 15 ‘in those days’; play on al’la a. al’lay; v. next w.) א' וּוַי וכ' ‘ wine pressing’ (on Sabbath, Neh. l. c.) and ‘woe’ (persecution as punishment) were those days marked for.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ai!; desgraça!; lamento.
definicoes_originais: v. אלי II, ילל) woe.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 17, a. e.; v. next w. Tanḥ. Aḥaré 2, אלילים (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. 3.

verbetes.glosa_atual: causadores de desgraça; expressão jocosa aplicada a insensatos.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) woe-makers, a word coined for playing on הֹולְלִים (Ps. LXXV, 5, a. e.).
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 20; a. e.; v. וַויָּנַיָּיא for correct vers.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cercar; rodear; ligar ou atar; crescer em força; tornar-se vigoroso.
definicoes_originais: , v. אָלַל)
[to surround]; to connect, tie (cmp. אסר.
to grow, be strong, v. אֲלַם.
notas_originais: חגר); intr. to be tied up, excluded, lonely, mute; v. אִלֵּם, אַלְמֹון II, אַלְמָנָה, אוּלָם.
Cmp. אַלְמֹון I. [Cmp. אֵלֶם Ps. LVIII, 2, LXX ἄρα, a. v. אוּלָם I.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser ou tornar-se forte; crescer; amarrar; ficar mudo; fortalecer; dominar; reunir forças.
definicoes_originais: intr.
to be or grow strong, to grow.
to tie, v. אֲלוּמָּא.
to be mute; v. Ithp.
to be strong, v. supra.
to strengthen, support.
to overpower.
to make one’s self strong, to summon strength.
to become mute, be silenced.
notas_originais: אֲלֵים (אַלֵּים Pa., עלים) (v. preced.)

Targ. I Chr. XXII, 12 (13) אֲלַם (h. text אֱמָץ, Var. עילם). Targ. O. Deut. XXXI, 6; 7; 23 ed. Vien. א' (ed. Berl. ע', v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 59).—B. Bath. 124 a; 135 b (he left them) דיקלא וא' a slender palm-tree and it grew thick.

Targ. II Chr. XI, 17; a. e. Part. pass. f. מְאַלְּמָא resolved, insisting upon. Targ. Ruth I, 18 (h. text מתאמצת).—B. Kam. 90 a אַלְמוּהָ רבנן וכ' the Rabbis fortified the husband’s right (gave him superior privileges). Kidd. 43 a אַלּוּמֵי קא מְאַלִּימְנָא למילתיה (Rashi אַלְּמוּהָ) we (the court) give him privileges.
Sabb. 156 b אַלְּמֵיה יצריה his appetite overwhelmed him.
. Targ. Job XXXVI, 19.
Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 10. Targ. Koh. XII, 6. [Targ. Ps. XC, 10 מִתְאַלְּמִין (for h. text בָּהֶם?). [Targ. Job VI, 6 Ms. Vers. מִתְאַלֵּם (?), h. text חלמות!.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: mudo; incapaz de falar; também ignorante.
definicoes_originais: cmp. חֵרֵשׁ) mute, unable to speak, also ignorant.
notas_originais: Ter. I, 6; a. fr.—Ruth. R. to IV, 1 (ref. to almoni, Ruth. l. c.) א' היה מד"ת he was unable to speak of (excluded from) the Law (ignorant).— Pl. אִילְּ' אִלְּמִין אִלְּמִים. Snh. 71 a; 100 a.—Fem. אִלֶּמֶת, אִילֶּ'. Num. R. s. 9. Ḥull. 79 a. Sot. 10 b אי'; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mudo; forma aramaica de אִלֵּם; plural אִילְּמֵי.
notas_originais: Targ. Ex. IV, 11.— Pl. אִילְּמֵי &c. Ḥag. 3 a; Yalk. Ex. 356; Deut. 440. [Ḥull. 76 b חד אילימא, v. אִלֵּימָא II, 2.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: forte; ver אַלִּימָא.
definicoes_originais: strong, v. אַלִּימָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: confirmação; consequentemente; portanto, em fórmula dialética.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. b. h. אֵלֶם, v. אָלַם) confirmation; (dial. term) consequently.
notas_originais: Pes. 2 b א' אור וכ' consequently ôr means day-light. Sabb. 151 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: por quê?; por qual razão?; de onde se conclui?; forma interrogativa.
definicoes_originais: (= על למה) why?, wherefore? Erub. 3 a אלמא אמר וכ' why did R. … say &c.?—Yoma 2 b אלמה לא ניבעי וכ' why should separation not be required &c.?; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: coral vermelho; também espécie de madeira de cedro ou madeira coralina em tradição interpretativa.
definicoes_originais: red coral.
pl. אַלְמוּגִים, אַלְמוּגִין a species of cedar-tree, prob. coral-wood (v. infra as to various opinions).
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13; Kel. XIII, 6; Sabb. 59 b; Y. ib. VI, 8 b top.

R. Hash. 23 a; B. Bath. 80 b sq. א' כסיתא almugim is coral (apparently a confusion of coral and coral-wood). Y. Keth. VII, end, 31 d א' אלוים alm. is the aloe-wood (agallochum); (Gen. R. s. 15 beg. אלווס Ar., ed. אלוום, אלונים corr. acc.). Pesik. R. s. 33 (ref. to II Chr. II, 7 a. I Kings X, 12); v. גלומי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: coral ou madeira preciosa designada pelo vocábulo anterior; forma aramaica.
definicoes_originais: , pl.אַלְמוּגִין, אַלְמוּגַיָּיא ch. same.
notas_originais: Targ. I Kings X, 11; 12. II Chr. IX, 10; 11.

verbetes.glosa_atual: nome de árvore, talvez variedade de cedro, carvalho ou terebinto.
definicoes_originais: (v. אלם) a cedar species, oak [or terebinth].
notas_originais: . R. Hash. 23 a; B. Bath. 80 b; v. בּוּטְמָא a. בְּלוּט.

verbetes.glosa_atual: viúvo; homem sem esposa por falecimento.
definicoes_originais: , v. אלם) [ tied up, secluded; cmp. Targ. I Sam. XXI, 3 טמיר for h. אלמני] widower.
notas_originais: Keth. 7 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Almoni; nome próprio masculino, relacionado a desconhecido.
definicoes_originais: m. (b. h. אַלְמֹנִי unnamed, unknown, v. preced.) pr. n. m. Almoni.
notas_originais: Ruth R. to IV, 1 פלני א' וכ' the man’s name was Ploni Almoni. Cmp. אִלֵּם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir a leitura para אַלְמוּג.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13 read אַלְמוּג.

verbetes.glosa_atual: porto; abrigo de embarcações; provável corrupção de palavra grega λιμήν.
definicoes_originais: (prob. corrupt., for לִימִין λιμὴν) harbor.
notas_originais: Y. Succ. II, beg. 52 d בנתונה בא' when the ship lies in port.

verbetes.glosa_atual: se não fosse; a não ser que; caso não; em outra construção, se realmente.
definicoes_originais: (= (= אילו־מא־לָא) if in any way not, if not, but for (usu. without verb or followed by שֶׁ־ or דְּ־; cmp. אִלֵּימָא I, .
(= אִילּוּ־מא־לֻא: cmp. אִלֵּימָא I, 2) if indeed.
notas_originais: Snh. 49 a א' דוד וכ' but for David (studying the Law), Joab could wage no war. Meg. 12 b א' אגרות וכ' but for the previous letters. Tanḥ. Ḥukkath 1 (ed. Bub. 1 אם לא); a. fr.

Meg. 24 b אלמלי אתה לוי [Ms. M. אלמלא לוי אתה) if thou wert a Levite. Keth. 33 b אלמלא נגדוה וכ' if they had lashed Hananiah &c. Sabb. 118 b; a. fr. [A differentiation of spelling which may have existed for the two opposite meanings of our w., is untraceable; v. Lowe, Pesachim, p. 28.] Cmp. אִילּוּלֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: enviuvar; deixar viúva; privar do cônjuge; abandonar.
definicoes_originais: (deriv. of next w.) to reduce to widowhood, bereave, desert.
notas_originais: Pes. 49 a ומְאַלְמֵן את אשתו will be forced to desert his wife (to leave his home).— Nithpa. נִתְאַלְמְנָה to become a widow. Y. Keth. II, beg. 26 a (Mishn. ed., a. Talm. Bab. נִתְאַרְמְלָה, v. אִרְמֵל).

verbetes.glosa_atual: viúva; mulher cujo marido morreu.
definicoes_originais: v. אַלְמֹון) widow.
notas_originais: Keth. I, 1; 2, v. אֵרוּסִין. Kidd. 75 a אַלְמָנַת עיסה the widow of one of spurious descent; v. עִיסָה; a. fr. Trnsf. דלת א' a frameless door (or made of one piece). Erub. 101 a; v. גַּשְׁמָה.—Denom.

verbetes.glosa_atual: viuvez; condição de pessoa viúva.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) widowhood.
notas_originais: B. Bath. VI, 4 בית א' (98 b; Ms. M. אַרְמְלוּת) a house in which to live in case of widowhood. Yeb. 45 a; a. e. Y. Keth. V, 29 d bot. הרי אני מיגדת אַלְמְנוּתִי, v. אָגַד II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲלוּנְטִית I.
notas_originais: , v. אֲלוּנְטִית I

verbetes.glosa_atual: em grego; na língua grega; helenicamente, de ἑλληνιστί.
definicoes_originais: (read אלי' ἑλληνιστί) Hellenic, in Greek.
notas_originais: Tanḥ. Tsav, 2 [a gloss] לשון א'קטבך קטאב"א in Greek katab’kha (Hos. XIII, 14) means κατάβα descend; v. Yalk. Jer. 333. Y. Sot. VII, beg. 21 b שמע קלון קריין שמע אלונ' heard them read the Sh’ma in Greek.

verbetes.glosa_atual: varas para carregar pesos sobre os ombros de duas ou mais pessoas.
definicoes_originais: , אֲלוּנְקֵי f. pl. (= על־ענקא on the neck) poles used to carry burdens on the shoulder of two or more persons (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Falangæ, phalangæ, which is of Semitic origin).
notas_originais: Bets. 25 b what means ‘provided no carrying on shoulders takes place’? Ans. באלנקי … Ar., Ms. M. (ed. באלו') by means of alanke (phalangæ). Ib. למיפק אאלו' ed. (Ms. באל') to be taken out &c. (carried in a sedan chair through which poles are put). Ib. Am. and Mar Zut. allowed themselves to be carried on shoulders of men בשבתא דריגלא באלנ' Ar., Ms. M. (ed. our w. absent) on a Sabbath during the festive week on phalangæ (to the lecture room). V. בְּלוּנְקֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: morder; triturar; mastigar ruidosamente.
definicoes_originais: , Pa. אַלַּס, אַלֵּיס (contr. of אלעס, v. לעס) to craunch, bite.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 84 a. Git. 70 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: Alas ou Valens; nome próprio de um amora.
definicoes_originais: Alas (Valens; v. וָולָס) 1) an Amora.
notas_originais: an Amora. Y. Kil. I, 27 a top.
(?) Snh. 64 a Sabta son of A.; v. אַבְלַס

verbetes.glosa_atual: Hélade; Grécia, também usada para Magna Grécia.
definicoes_originais: Hellas (= Græcia Magna).
notas_originais: [That Italian places are meant in quot. below, is obvious from Targ. Ezek. XXVII, 7, v. אִיטַלְיָא.] Targ. Y. I Gen. X, 4 א' וטרסס (h. text אלישה ותרשיש) Hellas and Taras (Tarentum, v. טַרְסִיס); Targ. Y. II ib.; Y. Meg. I, 71 b bot. אלסטרסס; Gen. R. s. 37, beg. אלוסטרוס, אלסיט' (corr. acc.). [Targ. Y. a. Midr. reflect geograph. a. ethnograph. conditions and notions of their own days.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ruínas; vestígios de grutas fortificadas perto de Tiberíades; topônimo Ilsis.
definicoes_originais: [the final ס freq. read ם in ed., as אֲלִיסִים &c.] f. (v. אָלִיס) pr. n. pl. Ilsis &c. (grottoes near Tiberias; v. Jos. B. J. II, 20, 6) ruins of fortified caves.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to III, 9 אלס'. Y. Shebi. IV, 35 c top אליפיס; Gen. R. s. 34 אילטיס; Ruth. R. to I, 17 (או') אילוסיס; Yalk. Ezek. 351 אלפטס; cmp. בְּטִיטָא a. אִיצְטַדִּין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִלְצָרִין.
notas_originais: , v. אִלְצָרִין

verbetes.glosa_atual: Eleazar; nome próprio.
definicoes_originais: Elazar.
notas_originais: E. b. Poïra, counsellor of John Hyrcanus. Kidd. 66 a

Several Tanaim: a) E. b. Azariah; E. b. Arakh. of the second generation; b) E. b. P’rata; E. of Modim, of the third gener.—c) E. b. Jacob; E. b. Shamua; E. b. Simon (bar Yoḥai); E. b. R. Yose the Galilean, of the fourth gener.

Several Amoraim: a) E. b. Antigonus; E. b. R. Yannai, of the second gener. Y. Ber. V, 9 b bot.; a. e.—b) E. bar Abina. Ib. I, 3 c bot.—c) R. Lazar or E. (in Babli E. b. P’dath) one of the most renowned Amoraim of the third gener. Erub. 65 b; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲלִיקִי.
notas_originais: , v. אֲלִיקִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: mil; numeral cardinal.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) thousand.
notas_originais: Du. אַלְפַּיִם.— Pl. אֲלָפִים.—א' אלפים a million. Gen. R. s. 8 שני א'; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 5 אַלְפַּיִם two thousand (men); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mil; forma aramaica com plural אַלְפִין.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XXXVIII, 25 אַלַּף ed. Berl. (Y. אלפא); a. fr.—Snh. 95 b חד א' one thousand. Bekh. 8 b מאה א' זוזי one hundred thousand zuz; a. fr.— Pl. אַלְפִין, אַלְפַיָּא. Targ. Ex. XXXVIII, 26; a. fr. Targ. I Sam. XVIII, 8; a. fr.—Y. Dem. VII, 26 b bot.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: acostumar-se; aprender; estudar; praticar; ensinar; treinar.
definicoes_originais: , √לף to join, be joined) to become used; to learn, study, train one’s self.
to train, teach.
as Pa. Lev. R. s. 30 (מַלֵּיף) מֹולִיף עלי זכו offers arguments in my favor.
to exercise, practice, exert one’s self.
notas_originais: —אֲלִיף accustomed, used to. Targ. I Sam. XVII, 39. Targ. O. Num. XXII, 30.—Targ. Deut. V, 1; a. fr. (v. also יְלֵיף).—Cant. R. to II, 2 צבי רבי דייליף would you like to study? B. Bath. 111 b top גוד לית דין צבי למילף take me away from here, this man has no desire to learn (but only to argue). Taan. 4 a man is bound למֵילַף נפשיה בניחותא [prob. למַלֵּיף, v. infra] to train himself to be gentle; a. fr.

Targ. Ps. XVIII, 35 מַלֵּיף (= מְאַלֵּף). Targ. Prov. XI, 25; a. fr.—Koh. to IX, 10 thou didst emigrate למילף for the sake of studying, והוא גלי לאַלָּפָא but he emigrated for the sake of teaching. Y. Dem. I, 22 a top ולא כן אַלְּפָן רבי (not איל') did you not teach us thus?—א' זכו, v. infra.
Targ. Is. II, 4; XXVI, 9.

verbetes.glosa_atual: álef; primeira letra do alfabeto hebraico.
definicoes_originais: Alef, the first letter of the Alphabet.
notas_originais: Y. Snh. I, 18 a bot.; a. fr. Y. Yeb. IV, 6 a כל שהוא בה"י רבה באל"ף רבא (referring to harbah arbeh Gen. III, 16) the embryo that counts harbah with Hé, (the numerical value being 212—days), will grow; that which counts arbeh with Alef (i.e. 208 days, or less than seven months) will lie down (die); (cmp. הַרְבָּה for differ. versions).—B. Bath. 168 b א' בית וכ' mere Alef Beth (arbitrary words). Gen. R. s. 1 הא' קרא תגר the Alef complained.—Y. Sabb. XVI, 15 c top א' בי"ת אחד one of the alphabetical acrostics (chapters) of Lamentations.— Pl. אלפ"ין. Sabb. 103 b. Ex. R. s. 38; a. e.—אָאִין. Y. Ber. II, 4 d bot. they pronounce עיינין א' Ayins like Alefs.—[Sabb. 103 b אלף אלף דאאזרך וכ' ed. (Ms. M. omits דאאזרך) they differ as to one who wrote on the Sabbath two such letters as Alef, Alef (of ăazzerkha Is. XLV, 5) being merely vowels; v. בגלטורי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: alfa; primeira letra do alfabeto grego, relacionada a álef.
definicoes_originais: ch. Alfa = Alef.
(ἄλφα) Alpha, the first letter of the Greek Alphabet.
notas_originais: Cant. R. beg. the poet כד עביד א' בית"א when writing alphabetical acrostics. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥama b. Ḥ.) מן תלתא תלתא פסוקי בא' בית"א belonging to the alphab. acrostics (in Lamentations) of three verses for each letter.; a. fr.
Shek. III, 2. Men. VIII, 1 א' לסולת best quality of flour. Ib. 6.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲלַף I.
notas_originais: , v. אֲלַף I

verbetes.glosa_atual: navio; embarcação; ver אִילְפָא.
definicoes_originais: ship, v. אִילְפָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: acrósticos alfabéticos; cânticos compostos segundo a ordem das letras.
definicoes_originais: (ἀλφαβητάριον) alphabetic acrostics, songs.
notas_originais: Ruth R. to III, 13 (ed. אלפנטרין, אלפבתרין, corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: acrósticos alfabéticos; variante aramaica.
notas_originais: m., pl. אַלֶּפְבֵּיתִין same. Koh. R. to I, 13; v. אלפ"א

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אלפבטרין.
notas_originais: , v. אלפבטרין

verbetes.glosa_atual: panela de tampa bem ajustada; caçarola de cozimento.
definicoes_originais: c. (= לֶפֶס q. v.) a tightly covered pot, stew-pot, contrad. to קדירה a boiling pot.
notas_originais: Ned. 51 a a dish goes first in a pot קודם שיורד לאי' before it is put in a stew-pot for steaming. Y. Ḥall. I, 58 a top.—Pes. 37 a מעשה אי' stew.—Gen. R. s. 1, end כא' וכיסויו as a pot with its lid.— Pl. אִלְפְּסִין. Bets. 32 a, v. אִירֹונִית.

verbetes.glosa_atual: variedade de pistache; árvore ou fruto, termo relacionado a alexandrino.
definicoes_originais: (Syr. אלסרא P. Sm. 155; 212; an abbrev. of אלכסנדרין, v. אֲלַכְסִין) a species of pistachio (tree or fruit).
notas_originais: Y. Dem. II, beg. 22 b; Y. Maasr. I, 48 d bot. אלצ'.—Tosef. ib. I, 1 אילס'. Ib. III, 14 אִילָאסָרִין ed. Zuck. (Var. אלרסין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: expressão corrompida de passagem sobre Onkelos, sobrinho de Adriano.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to I, 11 שלמד א' בדעתו של הקב"ה, a corruption; read: שלמד אונקלס (עקילס) בן אחותו של הדריינוס; cmp. Tanḥ. Mishp. 5. [The entire clause seems to be a gloss.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Alqum; nome próprio simbólico interpretado como ausência de permanência.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) a symbolized pr. n.: No-Standing.
notas_originais: Y. R. Hash. I, 57 a bot. ומלך א' עמו but the King (the Lord)—no standing (on his decrees) is with him; he desires not to insist upon his decrees (but permits repentance to set them aside).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִלְקְטִי.
notas_originais: , v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: escada em caracol; escada helicoidal, do grego ἑλικτή.
definicoes_originais: (ἑλικτή, sub. κλῖμαξ; v. also הִילְקְטִי) winding staircase.
notas_originais: Tosef. Erub. VIII, 11 (V, end) five compartments הפתוחות לא' ed. Zuck. (ed. אלקט) opening towards a common winding staircase. Ib. ואסורין בהילקטי ed. Zuck. (ed. באלקטון, Var. בדיאלקטו corr. acc.) and are forbidden the use of &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: monte de cereal; meda ou abrigo para feixes no campo.
definicoes_originais: , pl. אִלְקְטִיֹּות (לקט, v. הֶילְקֵט) stack of grain, shed for stacks in the field.
notas_originais: [Comment. fr. קייט summer.] Maasr. III, 7 the stores in הבורגנין והא' (Ms. M. אלנקטיות) turrets and sheds in the field are exempt from tithes (until brought home).

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma correspondente ao nome divino: Deus; ver אֱלֹוהַּ.
notas_originais: = אֱלָהָא, אֱלֹהִים, v. אֱלֹוהַּ

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir para ולוּקְיֹוס; ver גַּייוּס.
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 21, ed. Fr. p. 108 a, read ולוּקְיֹוס, v. גַּייוּס

verbetes.glosa_atual: Arkafta; alta dignidade ou magistratura persa.
definicoes_originais: (ἀργαπέτης, ארגבטא, Palm.
notas_originais: inscript., Zeitschr. der Deutsch. Morgenl. Ges. XVIII, 89—90; Syr. ארזבד, Pers. arzabedes; v. Perl. Et. St. p. 105) Arkafta, a high dignitary in Persia. Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 44 (ed. Vienna אַלְקַפֶּטַע); a. e.—Shebu. 6 b אלקפ'. Y. ib. I, 32 d bot. ארקב'. Y. Ber. II, 5 a top Ar. (ed. בסא …, corr. acc.).—Zeb. 96 b (prov.) ארקפת' נקטן ביד ריח' אתי ליה ליד Ms. M. (ed. אלקפתא נקטן ריחא …) the Ark. took us by the hand, and the scent came into the hand (undue pride of accidental acquaintances.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אַקְלַפְרִין.
notas_originais: , v. אַקְלַפְרִין

verbetes.glosa_atual: equivalente a אַלְקַפְטָא, dignitário persa.
notas_originais: = אַלְקַפְטָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: festa de regozijo; celebração pública ou privada, especialmente promovida por imperador.
definicoes_originais: (ἱλάρια) day of rejoicing, both private and public; esp. days of public rejoicings appointed by a new emperor, consisting of games, masquerades &c. Pesik. Sh’mini p. 193 b while the King is engaged בא' שלו וכ' in his hilaria, ask of him what you need.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to IV, 4 לא היו עומדין באלירא וכ' (corr. acc.) (at Mount Sinai) they did not stand (as) in hilaria, but in awe, trembling &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: nome de doença, possivelmente ileus, cólicas ou espasmos abdominais com vômitos; emenda incerta.
definicoes_originais: a disease; prob. a corruption of אִילְיָיא (εἰλεός, ileus) iliac passion, spasm of the abdominal muscles connected with vomiting.
notas_originais: Git. 70 a מיושב אחזתו א' Ar. (ed. דלריא as in the sentence following).

verbetes.glosa_atual: poste; estaca; batente ou umbral da porta.
definicoes_originais: (= h. אַלָּה) post, pole, door-post.
notas_originais: Targ. Josh. XXIV, 26 (ed. Vien. I אילנא).— Pl. (of אלותא) אַלְוָותָא. Targ. Is. VI, 4 אַלְוַות (ed. Vien. אֵילָוַות.) B. Bath. 73 a ומחינן ליה באלוותא Rashi (ed., sing. אלותא) and we struck it with clubs; v., however, אִלִּיתָא. Bets. 33 b ויהיב לן א' א' and gave us each several branches (Rashi), v., however, אַלְוָתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: tesoureiro-mor; encarregado principal dos tesouros.
definicoes_originais: (אַל = עַל, a. תוס', v. תּוּסְבְּרָא; cmp. I Chron. XXVII, 25); v. אַל־) comes thesaurorum, chief-treasurer.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. XV magor (his resort, stores) that is א' שלו his (the Roman Emperor’s) chief treasurer (or plur. treasurers).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Iltith; nome de peixe grande de identificação zoológica incerta.
definicoes_originais: Iltith, name of a large fish (prob. from its place, v. חוּלְתָּא).
notas_originais: Makhsh. VI, 3 (Mish. ed. אלתות). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 7.

verbetes.glosa_atual: imediatamente; no próprio lugar; sem demora.
definicoes_originais: (= עַל־אֲתַר) on the spot, forthwith, always with לְ־.
notas_originais: Gitt. III, 3 (Mish. Talm. Y. על אתר). R. Hash. 6 a; a. v. fr. (in Hebr. phraseol.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: se; quando; quer... quer...; indicação de hipótese ou alternativa.
definicoes_originais: if, when.
whether.
notas_originais: Mekh. Yithro, end כל א' שבתורה רשות every Im (If) in the Torah refers to voluntary actions (which you may or may not do) except three &c. Y. Gitt. VII, 48 d בגין דאמר א' because he said, If (I die), i.e. conditional divorce. Succ. 53 a א' אני כאן when I am here; a. fr.

Yoma III, 1; a. fr.—א' … א' whether … or. Y. Pes. VI, beg. 33 a א' פסח וכ' whether or not the Passover ceremonies supersede the Sabbath; a. fr. [Ib. אם יש תוחלת read יש וכ' אפשר, as before.]—אִם כֵּן (abbrev. א"כ) if this be so. Ber. I, 1; a. fr.—אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן (abbr. אא"כ) only when indeed, not until, unless. Keth. 76 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mãe; genitora; também útero ou abertura uterina.
definicoes_originais: mother, freq. = my mother.
womb, mouth of the womb.
notas_originais: Sabb. 134 a; a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81 c הניח חק אִמֹּו left his mother’s lap (Palestine).—Num. R. s. 10 (ref. to immo Prov. XXXI, 1) אמו זו … התורה וכ' ‘his mother’ that means the Law which trained Solomon and which is called a mother of those studying it, as you read (Prov. II, 3; text אִם is read אֵם ēm).

Ḥull. III, 2 (54 a) ניטלה האם וכ' if the mouth of the womb is absent, cut out. Bekh. IV, 4 (28 b).—Trnsf. legitimate existence, authority. Succ. 6 b, a. fr. יש א' למסורת the traditional Scripture text (letters without vowels) is authoritative in Biblical interpretation, opp. יש א' למקרא the traditional reading (vowels) must guide us, e.g. בחלב (Ex. XXIII, 19) may be read בַּחֲלֵב as the traditional vocalization, or בְּחֵלֶב in the fat of.— Pl. אִמָּהֹות, אִימָּהֹות. Kidd. IV, 4 her genealogy must be traced back ארבע א' to the mothers of four generations (on each side) which is eight mothers. Y. Snh. II, 20 b bot. they are not אֲמָהוֹת אלא אִימָּהוֹת maid-servants but mothers (of the nation).—Trnsf. א' של בצלים seed-onions. Peah III, 4. Erub. 29 a; a. e.—Ch. אִימָּא. [Koh. R. to XII, 7 א' דבצלי', v. אַמָּה.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִימָּא, mãe.
notas_originais: , v. אִימָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: côvado; medida antiga de comprimento; ver אַמְּתָא.
definicoes_originais: cubit, v. אַמְּתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: serva; escrava; forma aramaica de אָמָה.
notas_originais: f. = h. אָמָה. Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 18; v. אַמְהָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: dizer; falar; pensar; supor; introduzir hipótese ou objeção dialética.
definicoes_originais: , fut.
notas_originais: יֵימָא, imper. אֵימָא (√אם to join, v. אמר) to say, speak, think. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 10.—Freq. in Talmud.—אפילו תימא even if you will say, i.e. it may come right even if you assume that &c. Succ. 13 b; a. fr.—מי לֵימָא, (מי)נֵימָא, or לימא must it be said, does it mean to say? Ib.; a. fr.—(ואי) וכי תימא and if you should object. Ib.; a. fr.—אלא אימא but rather say, i.e. the correct version is. Ib.; a. fr.—אימא סיפא now read the second clause, i.e. how will you understand &c.? Ber. 21 b; a. fr.—אֵימָא I might think. Ib.; a. fr.—הוה אמינא I might have thought, I might have been led to believe. Erub. 74 b מאי הוה א' what might I have been led to believe?; a. fr.—נימא כוותיה let him express his opinion in agreement with his authority, i.e. why does he not say so expressly? Taan. 3 a; a. fr.—Pes. 7 b היכי נימא what else should he say? נימא למול should he use the expression lamol?—Gitt. 47 b, a. fr. ס"ד אמינא it may occur to you to think; v. דַּעְתָּא. Yoma 85 b אי הואי התם הוה אמינא had I been there, I should have said.—קאמינא = קא אמינא I say, speak of, v. קָא. Gitt. 47 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Emaús; cidade da planície da Judeia conhecida por fontes de águas termais.
definicoes_originais: (Ἐμμαούς, Ἀμμαούς, hellenized form of חמה, חמתה) Emmaus, Ammaus, a town in the plain of Judæa (or Philistæa), renowned, in Talmudic days, for its warm springs and luxurious life.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to VII, 7, a. e. [Ib. 11 אימוניס prob. אימאוס.] Cmp. דימסית. [Other forms: עמאוס, עמיס, אמאום, עמאים. For other places by that name, v. Neub. Géogr. p. 100.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: por quê?; por qual motivo?; por que não?
definicoes_originais: (= עַל מַאי = אַלָּמָּה) wherefore? why? א' לא why not? Sabb. 48 a.
notas_originais: Erub. 70 a; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: a quem?; para quem?
definicoes_originais: (= עַל מַאן) to whom?, v. אַ־ and מַאן.

verbetes.glosa_atual: multidão; séquito; cortejo; de origem persa.
definicoes_originais: (Pers. anbûh, Perl. Et. St. p. 18; cmp., however, מבוא עם Ezek.
crowd, escort.
notas_originais: Ezek. XXXIII, 3
Yoma 87 a; Snh. 7 b. Succ. 55 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: badalo de sino; literalmente, pequena uva.
definicoes_originais: , pl. אִמְבֹּולִין (= עִינְבֹּול; ענב) little grape, i.e. clapper in the bell.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. VI, beg. 7 d עשה להן אמבולי (corr. acc.) he put clappers in. V. אִנְבֹּול.

verbetes.glosa_atual: leitura corrompida; corrigir para אַמְבְּטַיָּא, torres ou ameias.
definicoes_originais: , Lev. R. s. 5 על א' דסדום Ar. (ed. by cler. error אילנייא) read אַמְבְּטַיָּא towers, battlements; v. אַנְבְּטַי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: embrulho; envoltório; capa ou fardo, relacionado ao latim involucrum.
definicoes_originais: (ἐμβούρικλον, imburuclum, corrupt. of involucrum, D.
notas_originais: C. s. v.) wrapper, cover, bundle. Y. B. Mets. IV, beg. 9 c המחליף א … ין בא' Ar. (read … ון; ed. אברוקלון באמבירוקלון, corr. acc.) if one exchanges one bundle for another; cmp. ציבור ibid.— Pl. אִנְבּוּרְקְרָאֹות. B. Kam. 114 b ed. (Ar. אנבקראות, Ms. M. אגבו', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

verbetes.glosa_atual: fundo; parte inferior; base.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) bottom.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 68, v. דְּיִיטֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: banheira; reservatório de banho.
definicoes_originais: (√בט, v. אַבְטָא; מ inserted) bath-tub, bathing reservoir.
notas_originais: Ned. IV, 4 (Var. טיא …). Ḥag. 15 a אב' Ar. (ed. אמב'); a. fr.— Pl. אִמְבְּטִיֹּות, אַמְבְּטָאֹות (אמבטיאות). Y. Sabb. III, 6 a.—Bab. ib. 40 a אמבטי' (Ar. אבטאות); Tosef. ib. III (IV), 3 ed. Zuck. אבטאות (Var. אמבטאות) baths in large cities with ambulatories (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Baths). [Y. Pes. III, beg. 29 d א' של בצק (?), prob. a corruption.] Cmp. בְּטַח II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cavaleiro; viajante montado; também jumento que acompanha camelo pelo deserto.
definicoes_originais: (ἀναβάτης, contr. ἀμβάτης) prop. rider, traveller on horseback &c.; hence (sub. חמור) an ass used for marching through the desert alongside of (and sometimes tied to) the camel.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. V, 7 b top מהו א' what is an ambates? חמר סלק the ass of the traveller (from Egypt to Asia). Y. Kel. VIII, 31 c אבהנוס, אבחטס (corr. acc.). V. לִיבְדְּקֹוס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: água de banho; resíduo líquido de banheira.
definicoes_originais: (deriv. of אמבטי) water of the bath-tub, waste of the bath-tub.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. VIII, 11 c ההן דמשזג (גו) א' וכ' he who washes (his anus) in &c., is liable to a disease of the rectum.

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir para אֶמְפִּירֹוס, marcado pelo fogo ou chamuscado.
definicoes_originais: , read אֶמְפִּירֹוס m. (ἔμπυρος) fire-scathed.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, v. אִימּוּס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: safra; colheita; estoque de cereal ou víveres.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. עִבּוּרָא; מ' inserted) crop, store.
notas_originais: Keth. 105 a smelt at (was an expert of) א' דחמרא (Rashi, pl.) wine stores.— Pl. אִמְבְּרֵי. Gitt. 56 a קלנהו להנהו א' וכ' set fire to all those stores of wheat and barley.

verbetes.glosa_atual: noz; fruto de casca dura.
definicoes_originais: (= אגוזא, v. foreg.) nut.
notas_originais: Sabb. 109 b מא' אליבא וכ' from eating a nut on an empty stomach. Men. 35 a כי א' in the shape of a nut; a. e.— Pl. אֶמְגּוּזֵי. Ḥull. 59 a. B. Mets. 60 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: mago; sacerdote persa; intérprete de sonhos; feiticeiro ou encantador.
definicoes_originais: magus, magian, a Persian priest and interpreter of dreams; magician, sorcerer.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. I Ex. VII, 15; VIII, 16.—B. Beth. 58 a. Yoma 35 a (Ḥull. 62 b) פרוה א' Parvah is the name of a Persian magus after whom the cell in the Temple was named.—Sabb. 75 a א' רב ושמואל Var. (read אַמְגּוּשְׁתָּא).— Pl. אַמְגֹּושֵׁי. Snh. 98 a אי בטלי יהירי בטלי א' when (in Israel) the haughty shall cease to exist, the magians (among the Persians) shall cease.

verbetes.glosa_atual: seguidor do magismo; crente em práticas mágicas.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) a follower of magianism, believer in sorcery.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 18 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: magismo; doutrina ou práticas dos magos persas.
definicoes_originais: (deriv. of preced. ws.) magianism, magian practices.
notas_originais: Sabb. 75 a א' רב ושמואל Ms. M. (ed. מגושתא, Var. אמגושא) as to magianism Rab and Samuel differ, one declaring it to be sorcery, the other—blasphemy.

verbetes.glosa_atual: referente ao sangue de circuncisão que tornou alguém prosélito.
definicoes_originais: referring to ( the blood) which made him a proselyte (circumcision).
notas_originais: Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a top ולא הוון אלא א' his visions as to bloodshed had reference only to that (blood) which made him &c.; v. גּוּר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: estimar aproximadamente; avaliar; calcular; julgar por apreciação especializada.
definicoes_originais: (√מד; v. מָדַד) to form an approximate estimate, to guess; to appraise, judge, deliver an expert’s opinion.
notas_originais: Erub. 58 b אוֹמְדוֹ וכ' he forms an approximate estimate of the height of the hill, and passes on. Snh. 78 b אֲמָדוּהוּ למיתה they (the experts) declared his injuries to be fatal; (Y. ib. IX, 27 a bot., also עמד') א' לחיים the opinion was that he would recover; a. fr.—Ḥull. 51 a אמדה נפשה the animal before taking a leap measures its strength.
same. Gen. R. s. 64 שהאמידו אותה they had appraised it (the field,—as to how much it would yield). V. אוּמָד

verbetes.glosa_atual: estimar ou conjecturar; formar opinião sobre alguém; forma aramaica.
notas_originais: Bekh. 61 a להכי אמדתיך I guessed this was thy intention. Keth. 68 a הא דאמידניה in the one case it means that we have formed an opinion about him (know whether he is stingy or liberal).— Part. pass. אָמִיד. Arakh. 20 a הא א' וקאי he stands appraised, he has been valued before this.—Hence אָמִיד believed to be wealthy. B. Kam. 62 a איניש א'. Keth. 85 b ידענא ביה דלא א' I know he is not rich. B. Bath. 8 b.—Ib. 52 a אם אֲמִידָא לך if you believe her to be wealthy. V. אוּמְדָּנָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cabana elevada de vigia sobre árvores; guarita com escada.
definicoes_originais: (= על מדלא, על מיד'; דלי; cmp. דָּלִית) watchman’s lodge on top of trees.
notas_originais: Sabb. 155 a דרגא דא' Ar., Ms. M. (ed. דמַדְלָא) ladder for climbing up to the lodge.

verbetes.glosa_atual: palavra de fórmula encantatória; sentido indeterminado.
notas_originais: a word in a charm formula. Sabb. 67 a Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. אמרלאי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: expressão talvez correspondente a de Daromah; leitura insegura.
definicoes_originais: = אִי מִדָּ' or from Daromah.
notas_originais: Y. Hor. III, end, 48 c

verbetes.glosa_atual: antebraço; braço; pênis em uso anatômico; também braço de rio, canal ou esgoto.
definicoes_originais: , v. אֵם)
fore-arm, arm.
א' דבצלי' an arm (direction-post) &c.; v. בְּצַל; Koh. R. to XII, 7 אם.
(= אצבע) membrum virile.
prop. river-arm, hence canal, dyke, sewer.
notas_originais: Sot. 12 b; Ex. R. s. 1 אמתה חד אמר ידה the word אמתה (Ex. II, 5)—one says it means אַמָּתָהּ, her arm, the other says it means אֲמָתָהּ, her maid-servant (v. אָמָה).—Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh.

—אַמַּת (בית) השחי the arm up to the axilla, arm-pit, name of an opening in a Temple door; v. however, infra. 4).—2) cubit, a measure equal to the distance from the elbow to the tip of the middle-finger. Keth. 5 b; Men. 11 a זו א' this one (the middle-finger) is used for defining the cubit measure. Kel. XVII, 10 אַמַּת הבנין וכ' the standard cubit of the Temple proportions was six, that of the vessels five hand-breadths. Sabb. 31 a א' הבנין the builder’s cubit (instrument).—א' על א' square-cubit. Yoma 31 a; a. e.—Zeb. 62 b (גרומה) א' גדומה; Y.
